facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on SG-9000 and TX-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining fire protection systems, specifically testing and inspecting fixed fire systems. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 27 November 2017 a potential incident was recorded on SG-9000 and TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
